title: End-to-End NLP Pipeline One Sheet
subject: Natural Language Processing
targetAudience: Postgraduate students who need a single-page map of the NLP pipeline from raw text through embeddings, language models, and sequence tagging.
summary: A cross-lecture one sheet for Natural Language Processing that compresses the end-to-end pipeline into a single revision page: tokenization and vector semantics, word embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe), language modelling and evaluation, large language models and prompt engineering, and POS tagging with Viterbi. It states the I/O, assumptions, comparisons, common mistakes, and one worked example per stage.
keyConcepts: Trace a token from raw text to a dense vector and onward to a downstream task.
Contrast count-based (GloVe) and predictive (Word2Vec) embedding methods.
Connect language-model perplexity to evaluation and to LLM prompting.
Apply the Viterbi algorithm to POS tagging as the canonical sequence-decoding step.
